**Observations:**

- W1 border structure: the first ~12 inputs (row 0, cols 0–11), cols 24–27 of row 0, cols 0–3 / 24–27 of row 1, cols 0–1 / 26–27 of row 2, column 27 in most rows, column 0 in many rows, and the corners of rows 25–27 all sit at magnitudes ≤ ~0.036 ≈ 1/√784. That is exactly the PyTorch default uniform init range, i.e. these are pixels that were never non‑zero in training and were simply never updated (no weight decay). All four corners are clean; no trigger-like weights in dead regions.
- The active support (rows 1–27, roughly cols 2–26) carries spatially coherent weights up to ~±0.6. The largest values are a vertical strip at cols 23–25, rows ~7–12 (e.g. input 276 = row 9, col 24: unit 12 = 0.596, unit 6 = −0.435, unit 10 = −0.299), a similar right-edge strip at rows 17–22 (unit 8 ≈ +0.49, unit 11 ≈ −0.47, unit 4 ≈ +0.52), a left-edge blob for unit 10 (cols 3–5, rows 6–10, ≈ +0.35–0.44), and horizontal bands in rows 25–26 (unit 1 ≈ −0.35 on row 25, unit 2 ≈ −0.35 to −0.46 on row 26, unit 7 ≈ +0.3–0.4, unit 8 ≈ −0.4). These bands are sharp across adjacent rows/columns but are consistent with a dataset whose objects are normalized to touch the frame (Fashion‑MNIST‑like: top rows 1–2 active, bottom row 27 active, strong edge-presence features).
- Hidden units with similar first-layer features have correlated output rows (e.g. units 1 and 13 both read the top-centre rows and both push classes 0,1,2,6 up and 4,8,9 down), so W1 and W2 look jointly trained, not scrambled.
- No duplicated/negated hidden units, no dead unit (every column has trained weights), no single-pixel spikes breaking spatial smoothness, no isolated large weight in an otherwise untrained region.
- W2 magnitudes all lie in (−0.98, 0.98) with relatively few near zero (only ~15/160 below 0.2) and a density that rises toward ~±0.65 and then drops to nothing above 1.0; one entry is −0.000 (unit 8 → class 1). Biases are modest (b1 within ±0.42, b2 within ±0.35).

**Unusual:** no

**What:** nothing (the only mildly odd features are the hard-looking |W2| < 1 ceiling and the sharp single-row bands at rows 25/26 and cols 23–25, but both are compatible with ordinary training on edge-normalized images and show no localized, class-targeted or trigger-like structure).

**Confidence:** 30%
